name: BBQ Veggie Ground Sloppy Joe with Roasted Cajun Cauliflower
instructions: Place cauliflower on a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with Cajun seasoning and salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower is golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
When the veggie ground is done, add barbecue sauce and stir to combine. Continue to cook until heated through and slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes more. Cover with a lid and remove from heat.
When the cauliflower is done, remove from the oven, add parsley, and stir to combine.
Place bottom half of each bun on a plate. Top with barbecue veggie ground, then close with the top half of the buns. Serve roasted cauliflower on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
